FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Montana fishing licence

Anglers aged 12 or older need a base fishing licence, Conservation Licence, and AIS prevention pass. The advertised base price does not include both required additions.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-12

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 12 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 11 or younger need none of the three fishing licence items.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-day base licencenon resident1 day$14 USD
Non-resident 5-day base licencenon resident5 consecutive calendar days$56 USD
Non-resident full-season base licencenon residentMarch 1 through the last day of February$100 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident Conservation Licence · $10 USD
    Required with the base fishing licence.
  • Non-resident Angler AIS Prevention Pass · $7.50 USD
    Required with the base fishing licence.

Rules visitors should know

  • A fishing licence cannot be transferred or refunded.
  • Children still must obey all catch limits and fishing rules.

How to buy

Use FWP's online licence purchase service.

License-free days

The 2026 free fishing weekends were May 9–10 and June 20–21. The exemption applied to residents and nonresidents; seasons, restrictions, and bag limits remained in force. Check FWP for the next dates.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Montana?

Anglers aged 12 or older need a base fishing licence, Conservation Licence, and AIS prevention pass. The advertised base price does not include both required additions.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Montana?

Non-resident 1-day base licence: $14 USD; Non-resident 5-day base licence: $56 USD; Non-resident full-season base licence: $100 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Montana?

Use FWP's online licence purchase service.
